name: Kyouiku Jisshuu ~Joshikousei Maniacs~
original_name: 教育実習 ～女子校生マニアックス～
source:
The plot of "Kyouiku Jisshuu ~Joshikousei Maniacs~" is rather simple: the protagonist is an ordinary Japanese man named Shingo, who is about to become an intern in a prestigious school. There is only one thing that makes the young man slightly nervous: all his students will be girls. And if that weren't enough, some of his new co-workers are young attractive women. Will Shingo concentrate on his job or succumb to the pleasures of the flesh?

[From [url=http://www.mobygames.com/game/pc98/kyiku-jissh-joshi-ksei-maniacs]Moby Games[/url]]
